what: Per-file byte budget of every int8 tflite. `const_bytes` is the sum of non-empty flatbuffer Buffers (real weights/biases/quant constants); `packaging_frac` is the fraction that is NOT constant data. Raw file size is only a weight proxy when packaging_frac is small.
measured_on: mixed -- see export_path per row (onnx2tf retired 2026-08-22)
measured_on_note: This file is no longer single-path. 77 rows were built with torch.onnx.export -> onnx2tf, the export path this repo retired on 2026-08-22 in favour of litert-torch + ai-edge-quantizer (see docs/PRUNING_HAZARDS.md section 4); those 77 have NOT been re-measured on the current path and every byte count in them is a property of that converter's output, not of the current one -- litert-torch packages the graph differently. The other 63 rows come from the current path. The per-row `export_path` field is authoritative; do not read a file-level claim off this note. The FP32 pruning-stage numbers are unaffected by the switch either way.
export_path_scope: Rows carry an `export_path` field. 77 are onnx2tf-era; 63 (everything under outputs/tflite_int8_litert/) come from the litert-torch + ai-edge-quantizer path that detection moved to on 2026-08-22. Do not average packaging_frac across the two -- it is an export-path property, not a model property. On efficientdet_lite1 the onnx2tf build spends 54.5% of the file on tensor names (11,916 tensors, 3,171 operators, packaging_frac 0.65); the litert build spends 7.3% (678 tensors, 305 operators, packaging_frac 0.24). The RULE this file supports -- report the compiled _edgetpu.tflite, not the intermediate -- holds either way; the RATIO does not transfer.
coverage: 154 rows. 133 were measured from files present on disk; 21 carry `source_present: false` -- their .tflite is gone, so the numbers are the measurement of the pass named in each row's `measured` field and cannot be re-derived here. Those 21 are: 4 under outputs/_attic_backbone_scope/ and 7 under outputs/tflite_int8/ (both deleted after the 2026-08-18 pass, see results/_deleted/), plus 10 under outputs/line_seg_cliff/, whose directory was removed on 2026-08-22 -- that dense sweep found no latency cliff and its rows survive in results/line_seg/{latency,report}.json. 136 of 154 rows have a params count. The 18 without split two ways: 11 have `pt_source: null` because no non-symlink .pt of that basename was found -- the pruned0pct baselines are symlinks into outputs/models/ and this script skips symlinks -- plus line_seg_w96_pruned90pct_magnitude_l2, see identity_notes; the other 7 are carried rows whose pt_source still records `load failed: ModuleNotFoundError` from the 2026-08-18 pass, which ran before the script put families/*/ on sys.path (that pass had 28 of 46 at null for this reason). Two dense line_seg baselines were rebuilt between passes: line_seg_link_r34_pruned0pct 28,834,880 -> 28,834,360 bytes (names 7,847 -> 7,471) and line_seg_w96_pruned0pct 8,705,808 -> 8,705,800 (names 1,631 -> 1,574); the current figures are the 2026-08-22 re-measurement. The litert path now covers all three line_seg variants (both 10-rung _param ladders for base128 and link_r34 were added on 2026-08-22 alongside the w96 rungs already here), plus reid, clip_rn50 and ssdlite, and the 19 efficientdet_lite2 rows added on 2026-08-27 are litert throughout; where an onnx2tf counterpart exists the pair is a direct converter comparison rather than a replacement. One row, line_seg_w96_pruned90pct_magnitude_l2, lost its pt_source pointer -- see identity_notes.
lite2_defect: RESOLVED 2026-08-27. The five efficientdet_lite2 rows used to carry a `defect` field: they were built with --pool-ceil, which is bit-exact with timm's SAME-pool only where the pooled extent is even, and Lite2 @448 has one odd site (7), so those files described a network whose P7 level was 3x3 instead of 4x4. The converter now picks the rewrite per site from the extent's parity (src/etpu/convert/export_litert.py:_same_pool_args), and all 19 Lite2 rows here are rebuilt from that path: FPN levels 56/28/14/7/4, 10 head outputs, 340/340 operators on the Edge TPU in 1 subgraph. Lite1 was never affected and rebuilds byte-identical through the new rule.

identity_notes.reid_youtu_lite_market1501_pruned0pct: outputs/pytorch_pruned/ held this as a symlink into a pre-rename tree (EdgeTPU_combinations_of_2_models/), i.e. it was dangling. Identity is not in doubt: the copy in deliverables/reid_youtu_lite_pruning_sweep/checkpoints_pytorch/ and outputs/models/reid_youtu_lite.pt have the SAME weights -- 26,655,296 parameters, sha256 over all state_dict tensor bytes a290d56ffdcb80ee for both. The 0% rung is the baseline, as the name says. The symlink was repointed at the deliverables copy on 2026-08-22.
identity_notes.mobilenetv2 vs mobilenetv2_imagenet: outputs/models/ carries both, 14,297,355 B and 14,300,299 B. They are the SAME MODEL: 314 tensors, 3,539,036 parameters, 1000-class head, and an identical sha256 over all state_dict tensor bytes (53e294308d19bfe8). The 2,944-byte file difference is pickle metadata. families/classification/imagenet_backbones/family.yaml names the convert entry mobilenetv2_imagenet, so that is the one the pipeline addresses; either file gives the same weights.
identity_notes.line_seg_w96_pruned90pct_magnitude_l2: This row lost its pt_source pointer: the path the 2026-08-18 pass recorded no longer exists and no .pt of that basename is on disk. The row's byte measurements stand; its checkpoint is unidentifiable from this repository. Note this is the non-_param rung -- the _param ladder rung of the same ratio is present and is what results/line_seg/param_ladder_oncar.json uses.
